legend: The Bunyip (Australia, Aboriginal billabong legend, 1847 skull)
lines: In Australia, old Aboriginal stories warn of a creature called the bunyip.
It lives in dark billabongs and swamps, they say, and waits for night.
Settlers in the 1840s began to report a strange beast in the water.
A shaggy body, a long neck, and a face like a dog.
Some only heard a deep roar rolling across the marsh.
In 1847, a strange skull went on show in Sydney, and crowds came to stare.
Experts later called it a deformed foal.
But the people of the swamps never stopped listening.
Would you camp beside a billabong tonight?
title: The Swamp Monster Australia Still Whispers About #shorts
description:
In Australian billabong legend, a shaggy beast with a long neck waits in the dark water. Settlers heard it roar, and a strange skull once drew crowds in Sydney.
